project_overview: This project appears to be a Vue.js application focused on an educational platform, likely managing student data and exam processes. The codebase demonstrates a layered architecture, with components like ‘ApplicationServices’ managing core logic and ‘ResultPage’ rendering examination results. The presence of ‘iLike’ modules suggests a personalized learning experience. Overall, it presents a moderately complex application with potential areas for architectural refinement.

layers.description: Responsible for the user interface and handling user interactions.
Contains the core logic of the application, potentially implemented using services or utility functions.

macro_trends.title: Potential Component Over-Reliance
macro_trends.description: Several Vue files (e.g., ‘ResultPage’, ‘iLikeCourses’, ‘iLikeCoursesNew’) heavily rely on direct routing and state management, potentially creating tight coupling and hindering maintainability. Refactoring to use a central state management solution could mitigate this risk.

macro_trends.title: UI/Accessibility Misalignment
macro_trends.description: Multiple files demonstrate potential issues aligning UI design with Accessibility guidelines, particularly regarding  structural inconsistencies and lack of appropriate ARIA attributes. A focused effort on accessibility best practices and component testing is warranted.

key_workflows.name: Exam Submission Workflow
key_workflows.description: This workflow involves the user interacting with ‘ExamFormSubmission.vue’, submitting their answers, and the system validating and processing the data.  A review of the data flow and validation logic is needed to ensure robustness and security.

key_workflows.name: Student Result Retrieval Workflow
key_workflows.description: This workflow involves the user navigating to ‘ResultPage.vue’ to view their examination results. Analysis of the data retrieval and display processes is essential for performance optimization and data accuracy.
